title: Discipline of the Pale Hand
summary: The school's first discipline of the pale hand that takes the colour and strength from a struck limb and the fever from a friend.

title: Manual of the Azure Quietus
summary: The school's manual of the sky-pale quiet that settles on a foe's limbs and on a friend's troubled meridians.

title: The Basin and Wane Canon
summary: The school canon of filling the qi field like a basin and letting it wane outward in slow grey waves.

title: The Dual-Track Terminal Crown
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of ending qi from the core that meet in one terminal crown.

title: The Gale Oath of Ebbing
summary: The school discipline of swearing the strength of a foe to ebb as a wind falls and the strain of a friend to ebb with it.

title: Plateau Fallow Reckoning
summary: The school reckoning of letting ground and body lie fallow so that nothing grows in a foe and all sickness ends in a friend.

title: The Gale-Sworn Entropy Canon
summary: The school canon of entropy sworn to the wind that ages whatever the gale crosses and spares the sworn.

title: The Oath Beneath the Last Wind
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the final wind and loosed from the core as an ending that nothing outruns.
